WITH acct_avg AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_avg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS figure
  FROM acct_avg
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.figure,
       r.figure - o.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg_by,
       r.figure / o.overall_avg AS figure_to_overall_avg_ratio
FROM region_avg r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.figure > o.overall_avg;
